jobs.description:

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) (f/m/d) for Field Services, you will influence supplier decisions and work with suppliers to develop them in alignment with Siemens Energy's needs for capacity, capability, and cost. Typical services include Scaffolding, Assemblies, Machining, Blasting, Welding, NDT, Mechanical and Electrical Installation, Commissioning, and Site Management. As part of a diverse team of professionals, you will leverage both your expertise and that of your team to ensure that our supply chain meets the highest quality standards.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Be the point of contact for the Field Service Global Commodity Manager in developing procurement strategies and project planning, supplier identification, capability assessment audits, and driving standards in alignment with codes and EHS requirements
* Lead a distributed team of Supplier Quality Engineers, fostering an environment of collaborative learning and training
* Support cross-functional teams in Execution Units with Product and Process Qualification (PPQ) for Field Service approvals, including planning, tracking, and reporting on project milestones, budget, and resource needs
* Act as a commodity expert in developing strategic suppliers and supporting critical technical issues by building and owning a commodity/technology network

* Degree or equivalent experience in electrical/mechanical engineering or a related field
* Longstanding professional experience in an area of Field Service, supplier quality management, procurement and EHS
* Experience performing supplier qualification, technical supplier assessment & development to provide a global quality-assured and cost-effective supply base
* Experience in leading projects and running virtual multi-functional teams in an international environment

In this role, you are a Senior Performance Controller & Digital Controlling Analyst for our Execution Unit Gas Services Distributed and act as a close finance partner to the operational management. * Act as the primary Performance Controlling contact for one Execution Unit, partnering closely with Execution Unit management

* Prepare and deliver monthly performance reports, forecasts, ad-hoc analyses and management presentations with a strong focus on KPIs, drivers and deviations

* Continuously improve controlling, reporting and management review processes, driving standardization, efficiency and quality
* Drive digitalization and automation initiatives (e.g. Power BI, data models, reporting logic), while collaborating closely with Finance colleagues across Execution Units and central functions

* Long-term experience in Performance Controlling and/or operational Finance, ideally in an industrial or project-based environment, with strong exposure to planning, forecasting and actuals

* Strong digital and analytical mindset with a clear interest in data-driven finance and digital transformation

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Head of Service Operations Controlling, you will have full responsibility for all controlling and reporting activities related to Europe and Africa Service Operations. 
This includes financial planning, forecasting, actual reporting, and analysis for multiple countries in Europe and Africa. You will directly lead a team of employees in Germany and coordinate with local business partner in the countries to ensure accurate and timely reporting & controlling. 
In this position you are responsible to steer the operational day-to-day controlling activities for field service & tooling cost centers. You will act as a business partner to Service Operations leadership, providing in-depth financial analysis, preparing scenario models for strategic decisions, and assessing risks for ongoing and new projects. You will also drive the implementation of process standardization, automation, and digitalization initiatives (including AI).

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Team Leadership & Development: Manage a team of up to 8 employees in Germany and a network of local business partner in several countries. Define Roles & Responsibilities set clear performance targets, conduct regular 1:1s, organize team workshops, and oversee talent development.
* Financials Planning, Forecast and actual reporting of Order Entry, Revenue, Revenue Margin and Free Cash Flow for Service Operations internal business with New Unit, On-shore Projects and other Business Areas
* Financial Planning, Reporting & Analysis: Own the annual budget process, prepare monthly forecast and actual reporting for Service Operations cost centers, Headcount and Capex. Consolidate data from all countries, analyze cost variances, and recommend corrective actions. Prepare and present management reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses for senior leadership.
* Ensure accurate tracking and operational management of all cost centers, collaborate with Service Operations Management and EU&AF Business Controlling
* Process Optimization & Digitalization: Map and standardize controlling processes across countries. Identify manual tasks and drive automation using SAP enhancements, RPA bots, and Power BI dashboards. Lead digitalization projects, including AI implementation for predictive analytics and reporting.
* Compliance & Internal Controls: Implement and monitor internal controls to ensure compliance with company policies, SOX requirements, and local regulations.

What You Bring

* Master’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a comparable field, or equivalent qualification (e.g., Siemens commercial apprenticeship combined with extensive professional experience), with long-term, in-depth experience in Business Controlling or Finance, particularly in closing, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Experience in Finance / BC, Sales or Project Management in Gas Services or with one of the Gas Services Execution Units Central or Distributed is preferred with basic understanding of the underlying business models and technical Siemens Energy products and solutions
* Proven leadership experience and ability to lead teams effectively in a matrix organization

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Head of Product Excellence (f/m/d) for the Steam Turbine and Generator (STG) business no day will look the same. The focus of the team is on collecting and reporting non-conformance data from across all the STG business segments as well as managing the processes for continuous improvement efforts.  Week-to-week, the rhythm changes focus from reporting the figures to evaluation of the results and ensuring the improvement activities are making progress. There are additional tasks that include Document Management, 3i, PCM, auditing and local support for different tasks where the employees are sitting.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Governance for Non-Conformance Cost (NCC) reporting for the STG business. This includes the NCC process, monthly reporting and visualization. Support the extended STG organization for all service lines and functions with information on next steps to help them meet the “not to exceed” targets.
* Governance for the CAPA (Corrective Action and Preventative Action) process. This includes the process, tools and training to ensure CAPA are being executed efficiently and effectively. KPI’s are then tracked by the EQS PE team for progress and reporting.
* Facilitate monthly Quality Ambassador meetings to involve the cross-functional organization with CAPA quality and lessons learned throughout the business
* Manage a diverse team of nine quality professionals who support Non-Conformance Management across five countries
* Oversee the document management system (BIC Cloud/SEPH) and ensure compliance with the SE requirements
* Support the SAP S4Energy transition as Capability Lead for STG EQS.  This responsibility requires working knowledge of the business processes and learning how the new SAP system will work.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in quality management or similar field
* Multiple years of experience in Quality Management or relevant field with proven capabilities for root cause analysis methods, basic statistical analysis tools and interpretation of results
* Knowledge of the ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 Integrated Management System preferred
* Working knowledge of SAP and MS Office Suite; AI Copilot a plus
* Excellent communication skills both verbal and written; fluency in English

Den Gamle Bagergaard in Maribo is looking for a baker. You do not need a formal qualification if you have practical experience working in a bakery.

We are a family-run business with three bakers and a pastry chef in production. Two packing staff and a driver help get our bread ready and delivered to our shops.

Your work

You will take part in the daily production at the bakery. We are looking for someone who knows their way around a bakery, takes responsibility for their work and enjoys working with colleagues. You must be able to communicate in Danish or understandable English.

You must already have the legal right to work in Denmark, for example through EU/EEA or Swiss citizenship or a valid Danish residence and work permit. We cannot offer visa or work permit sponsorship.

What we offer

Gross monthly salary: Based on qualifications and experience. For a qualified baker, the salary starts at approximately DKK 26,000.

Permanent, full-time employment

Pension scheme

5 weeks of vacation

Flexible benefits account

Additional pay for applicable night and Sunday work

The employer can support you in finding accommodation in the area

The planned working hours start at 01:30 on Mondays and 05:00 from Tuesday to Thursday. You will also work every other weekend. During the night shifts on Mondays and every other weekend, you will bake bread, Danish pastries and other baked goods. We will agree on the schedule together, and working night shifts only is also an option.

The expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Recruitment process

The first interview can be held online if needed. Selected candidates may be invited to visit the bakery before a final employment agreement is made.

We review applications as they arrive, so please apply as soon as possible.

How to apply

Send your application and CV to rekruttering@lolland.dk with "Baker - Maribo" in the subject line.

If you have questions, contact Martin Hansen, Business Consultant and EURES Adviser at Lolland Municipality, on +45 21 47 73 43 or maha@lolland.dk.

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and intermediaries to refrain from contacting us regarding this position. Applications will only be considered if submitted directly by candidates.

About Lolland and relocation support

Lolland is in southern Denmark and offers easy access to nature, beaches and open countryside, along with affordable housing and short commuting distances. The region is developing rapidly, partly due to the Femern Belt Fixed Link between Denmark and Germany.

If you are moving from abroad, Lolland Municipality's Newcomers Service can help with practical questions about relocation, registration, housing, a partner's job search and settling in Denmark. Read more at https://newcomers.lolland.dk/. You can also find information about working in Denmark at https://www.workindenmark.dk/

jobs.employer_name: Robotto Co ApS
jobs.description:
Job description:
Want to build C++ software that helps power the next generation of autonomous and unmanned systems?At Robotto, we build advanced autonomy and software solutions for drones and unmanned systems. Our technology brings together computer vision, C++ software, autonomy, embedded systems and real-world product development.

We are looking for a C++ Software Engineer to join our engineering team and contribute to the software that connects and powers different parts of Robotto's technology platform.This is a hands-on software engineering role for someone who enjoys building reliable systems, solving complex technical problems and seeing their software move beyond development into real-world operation.

The role:
You will develop and maintain C++ software across Robotto's software ecosystem, working on applications and services that support the operation, communication and coordination of our unmanned systems.Depending on the project, your work may span different parts of our platform-from software running alongside our autonomous systems to applications used to configure, control and interact with them.You will work closely with engineers across computer vision, autonomy, embedded software, electronics and testing to develop new capabilities, integrate components and continuously improve the reliability and performance of our systems.

What you will do:
- Design, develop and maintain high-quality software primarily in C++.
- Build software used across our drone and unmanned-systems platform.
- Develop reliable communication and data flows between different software and hardware components.
- Work on performance-sensitive and potentially real-time or near-real-time applications.
- Integrate software with APIs, networking components, sensors and wider system infrastructure.
- Debug complex issues across interconnected software systems and identify root causes.
- Contribute to software architecture and technical design decisions.
- Write maintainable, testable and well-structured production code.
- Participate in code reviews, testing, documentation and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.
- Collaborate closely with computer vision, embedded, autonomy and hardware engineers.
- Support integration and testing on real systems and drone platforms.

What success could look like in your first 3-6 months:
- You have developed a strong understanding of Robotto's software architecture and how the different parts of our platform work together.
- You are contributing production-quality C++ code to our products.
- You have taken ownership of features or components from development through integration and testing.
- You are successfully debugging and solving issues across interconnected systems.
- You are contributing to improved reliability, maintainability and performance of our software.
- You have become a trusted technical partner within the engineering team.

What we are looking forWe are looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building software that interacts with real systems.
- Strong professional experience developing production-quality software in C++, with a solid understanding of modern software engineering practices.
- Solid understanding of software architecture, data structures, algorithms and object-oriented design.
- Experience developing multi-component or distributed software systems.
- Experience with networking, inter-process communication, APIs or communication protocols is highly relevant.
- Good understanding of concurrency, multithreading and performance considerations in C++.
- Experience with debugging, testing, version control and modern software development practices.
- Experience with Linux-based development environments is an advantage.
- Experience with robotics, drones, autonomous systems, defence technology or other complex technical products is an advantage, but not a requirement.
- Experience working with software that interfaces with hardware or real-world systems is an advantage.
- Professional fluency in English.
- A degree in computer science, software engineering, robotics or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience is equally welcome.

Please apply even if you don't meet every single point. We are interested in what you can bring to the team, your ability to learn and your motivation to work on the challenges we are solving.

Who you are:
Beyond your technical or professional experience, we care about how you work and collaborate.You:
- Are curious and enjoy solving complex problems.
- Take ownership and follow things through.
- Communicate openly about progress, challenges and risks.
- Are comfortable in a growing company where priorities can evolve.
- Enjoy collaborating with people across different disciplines.
- Value testing, learning and continuous improvement.
- Want to contribute rather than simply execute a predefined set of tasks.

Why join Robotto?
Robotto is building advanced autonomy technology for drones and unmanned systems, working at the intersection of software, hardware, computer vision, autonomy and real-world operations.You will be joining Robotto at an exciting stage of our journey as we continue to grow our team, technology and products.

Our teams work across software, computer vision, control, electronics, hardware and real-world testing. This means you will work closely with people from different technical disciplines and see how your work contributes to the wider product.

We are an ambitious and collaborative team, and we value people who take ownership, challenge ideas constructively and want to help build both great technology and a great company.This is not a role where everything is already defined. You will have the opportunity to:
- Work on challenging technology with real-world applications.
- Have meaningful ownership and influence over your area.
- Work closely with talented colleagues across multiple disciplines.
- See your work move from an idea or prototype into real-world use.
- Help shape how we work as the company continues to grow.

More information and application:
 https://careers.robotto.ai/jobs/8397119-software-engineer-c
